name: Kanojo x Kanojo ga Torareta!?
original_name: 彼女×カノジョがとられた!?
source:
Jin and his girlfriend Chisato are average college students. 
But when Chisato casually runs into a cute shonen who seems like a girl 
it starts a chain of events that become love betrayals. 

Four characters 
Multi-scenario ADV game 
Lots of crossdressing/netorare

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084118.html]DLsite English[/url]]
